meta.description: Give your AI agent its own blockchain wallet without ever exposing private keys.

copy.tagline: 为AI agent创建区块链钱包，无需暴露私钥
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构建需要自主管理链上资产的AI agent
copy.tagline_en: Create a blockchain wallet for your AI agent without exposing private keys
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building AI agents that need to manage on-chain assets autonomously

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以拥有自己的区块链钱包，能转账和调用智能合约，但永远看不到私钥。所有交易由服务端执行，受钱包主人设定的策略控制。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 创建钱包、查询余额、转账或与智能合约交互时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个以太坊钱包，备注为“测试钱包”。
say.note: Claude 会生成钱包并返回 claim URL 和地址。
Claude 会返回当前钱包的原生代币余额。
Claude 会发起转账，若策略允许则执行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can have its own blockchain wallet, transfer tokens, and interact with smart contracts without ever seeing the private key. All transactions are executed server-side and controlled by policies set by the wallet owner.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create a wallet, check balance, transfer tokens, or interact with a smart contract.

say_en.text: Create an Ethereum wallet with memo 'test wallet'.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a wallet and return a claim URL and address.
Claude will return the native token balance.
Claude will initiate the transfer if allowed by policies.
